name: prismaticChemtrails
description: Prismatic chemtrails: a filter-style effect that looks like viewing the scene through a prism at a sky full of dissolving chemtrail wisps. ELEMENTS: (1) Radial spectral dispersion — 16-20 sample taps displaced outward from frame center, each tap's displacement scales signed (t-0.5)*dispersion*centerDist, tap color weighted by a saturated cosine rainbow palette (red outermost, violet innermost), accumulated with center-weighted Gaussian-ish weights so the frame center stays sharp and dispersion blooms toward edges. (2) Anisotropic FBM wisps — 5-octave value-noise FBM with domain stretched vertically (uv.x*1.0, uv.y*6.0) to form horizontal trail streaks, pale steel-blue/white (0.85,0.88,0.92) base tint. Wisps undulate with a pendulum drift: noise domain offset by driftAmount*sin(time*TAU) horizontally plus a second parallax layer offset by driftAmount*cos(time*TAU) moving oppositely. A gentle timeCircle vec2(cos(time*TAU), sin(time*TAU))*0.3 added to the noise coordinates gives organic undulation. (3) Iridescent sheen — where wisp density and radial center-distance are both high, wisps are tinted by the spectral cosine palette shifted by hueOffset + 0.05*sin(time*TAU*2.0); dispersion amount is wisp-modulated via mixWisp. (4) Dispersion breathing — dispersion scales by 0.8+0.2*sin(time*TAU). ANIMATION: every animated value is a pure sinusoid of time*TAU with INTEGER cycle counts (1 or 2); noise domain moves only via sin/cos oscillation and timeCircle sampling, never raw time ramps. COLOR: bright airy pastel-to-vivid — pale blue-white base interrupted by saturated full-spectrum bands; smoothstep-weighted taps, no banding, no channel-only fringing.

name: psychedelicplasmatunnel
description: A first-person infinite flight through a luminous psychedelic wormhole tunnel. Polar coordinates from aspect-corrected centered UVs: angle = atan(p.y, p.x), radius = length(p), depth = 0.3 / radius, with radius clamped to avoid center moire. Breathing flight motion: depth offset of speed * sin(time * TAU * 2.0). Whole tunnel barrel-rolls exactly 1 full integer turn per loop via rotation of centered coords by TAU * time. Vortex swirl: angle offset by swirl * depth, breathing as swirl * (0.8 + 0.2 * sin(time * TAU * 2.0)). Tunnel walls covered in flowing domain-warped FBM plasma in tunnel space (angle wrapped into 8 repeating slices plus depth term), animated via 4D noise on the timeCircle vec2(cos(time*TAU), sin(time*TAU)). Self-warp the FBM for organic liquid flow; per-octave rotate+scale domain to avoid artifacts. Depth fog exp(-depth * fog) recedes the far tunnel to black. Glow rings racing toward the viewer, brightness pulsing at 0.5 + 0.5*sin(time * TAU * 3.0). Color: IQ cosine palette, phase advancing exactly TAU * time per loop (one full seamless rainbow cycle) plus colorShift. Post-process in the same pass: gamma lift pow(color, 0.85), saturation boost via negative luma-mix, glow bloom approximation via exp/pow on bright filaments, subtle intensity pulse at 3 integer cycles. No hard edges, no tiling seams, no text. Production-quality rave music-visualizer wormhole VFX.

name: chromeicosahedroninterior
description: A surreal view from inside a perfectly reflective chrome icosahedron. The camera slowly orbits inside the 20-faced polyhedron, watching multiple internal reflections create an infinite kaleidoscopic mirror effect. Chrome surfaces exhibit Fresnel-based reflectivity with bright glowing edges at grazing angles. A procedural environment creates surreal color bands visible in the reflections - cool metallics shifting through cyan, silver, and hints of gold. Edge glow pulses softly. Chromatic aberration adds prismatic rainbow fringing to reflections. The overall aesthetic is ethereal, metallic, and hypnotically geometric.

name: aerialsunsetflyover
description: First-person aerial view flying forward over a surreal alien landscape at ~40m altitude. The ground occupies ~65% of the frame, displaying sweeping bands of vibrant color — electric purples rolling into deep teals, volcanic oranges and lime greens — like psychedelic geological formations seen from above. Near terrain is crisp with visible FBM ridge detail and strong perspective convergence lines. By 150 virtual units distant, terrain colors wash toward warm cream-orange fog; by 300 units only silhouette shapes remain dissolved in haze. The horizon is completely washed out into a blindingly bright warm cream-orange atmospheric glow. Sky transitions from deep violet-indigo at the top through a magenta band narrowing into the horizon glow. A soft overexposed sun disc sits just above center-horizon, surrounded by a wide corona bloom and horizontal lens-streak artifacts. The camera breathes gently with a vertical Y-axis bob and lazy lateral banking. ALL animation uses sin(time*TAU) and cos(time*TAU) exclusively. Terrain forward motion is achieved by offsetting the FBM spatial coordinates using timeCircle = vec2(cos(time*TAU), sin(time*TAU)) scaled by speed — this traces a circle in the noise field giving seamless looping terrain scroll. Camera Y bob: sin(time*TAU)*2.5 (1 cycle). Banking: sin(time*TAU)*0.06 (1 cycle). Hue drift adds sin(time*TAU)*0.4 to cosine palette t-parameter. Sun Y oscillates with sin(time*TAU)*0.04. Lens flare pulse uses sin(time*TAU*2.0) (2 integer cycles). Post-processing: subtle chromatic aberration at screen edges, circular vignette, soft film grain from hash noise, sun corona/streak lens effects.
